title: Families
note: Gentle terrain near the base, ski schools and childcare, sledging and an ice rink, easy access and fair prices.

title: Snowboarders
note: Few drags and few flat stretches, enough terrain at intermediate level, parks and trees.

title: Park rats
note: Size and number of snow parks, with enough riding around them.

title: Foodies
note: Michelin 2026 stars and Bib Gourmand, Gault&Millau toques, then restaurant and food shop counts.

title: Non skiers
note: Spas and pools, winter walks and cross country, culture, an ice rink and restaurants reachable without skis.

title: Budget friendly
note: Cheap passes for the skiing on offer. Accommodation, pint and meal prices are still to be added.

title: Party animals
note: Reputation in nine independent guides, named bars, nightclubs and slope après venues, festivals, and mapped bars.

title: Large groups
note: Terrain for every level at once, plenty of places to stay and eat, and easy to reach.

title: Experts & Off Piste
note: Off piste reputation and named routes, glaciers by lift, steep terrain and vertical. Needs at least 10 km of advanced piste.

title: Beginners
note: Plenty of green and blue terrain, few drags and flat stretches, ski schools nearby and fair prices.
